description: Post the user's reply on one of their bug reports, with optional screenshotPaths read from this machine (images only, at most 5, 5 MB each). A reply on a needs_info ticket returns it to triaged; on a fixed or closed ticket it reopens it within 14 days, and after that the backend refuses with bug_report_reopen_window_elapsed: file a new report naming the old shortId instead. Returns the new timeline activity.

bugReportId.description: Bug report ID (bugReportId from create or list), not the short id shown to people

message.description: The user's reply on the ticket

screenshotPaths.description: Absolute paths of up to 5 screenshots on this machine (png, jpg, gif or webp, at most 5 MB each). They are read from disk and uploaded with the report.

name: muggle-remote-bug-report-reply
